import sys

def find_possible_message(t):
    n = len(t)
    
    # Check for trivial cases where no error is possible
    if n <= 1 or t[:n//2] != t[n//2:]:
        return "NO"
    
    # Try to find the maximum overlap
    for i in range(1, n//2):
        if t.startswith(t[i:]):
            return "YES\n" + t[:i+n//2]
    
    return "NO"
